name: multicolumn-keyboard-15236418
description: Клавиатура многоколоночных наборов (задача 15236418, стандарт b6b2821d): ←/→ в «Полках» публикаций ходят к соседу своего ряда (у края ряда — не перехватываются и не прыгают через ряд), Ctrl+↑/↓ сворачивают/разворачивают полку (прежняя роль ←/→), Ctrl+↑/↓ работают из поля поиска, в виде «Список» ←/→ полку не сворачивают. Честный красный гейт: на дофиксной сборке ←/→ на ЗАГОЛОВКЕ полки ещё сворачивают её (прежняя роль), Ctrl+↑/↓ полку не сворачивают (Ctrl+↑ читается как обычная ↑), в «Списке» ← на заголовке сворачивает полку. Засев: 14 публикаций через API (свежая сеть имеет пустую полку по умолчанию и группу «Без полки»; карточки — в несколько колонок, несколько рядов). Запуск: node client/scripts/ui-probe-stand.mjs --scenario client/scripts/ui-probe.15236418-multicolumn-keys.scenario.json.

steps.name: cards-in-multiple-columns
steps.probe: (() => { const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pub-card')]; if (cards.length < 2) return false; const top = Math.round(cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().top); return cards.filter((c) => Math.round(c.getBoundingClientRect().top) === top).length >= 2; })()

steps.name: cards-in-several-rows
steps.probe: (() => { const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pub-card')]; const rows = new Set(cards.map((c) => Math.round(c.getBoundingClientRect().top))); return rows.size >= 2; })()

steps.name: focus-first-card
steps.eval: (() => { const card = document.querySelector('.pub-card'); if (card === null) return false; card.focus(); return document.activeElement === card; })()

steps.name: first-card-focused
steps.probe: document.activeElement !== null && document.activeElement.classList.contains('pub-card')

steps.name: first-card
steps.probe: document.querySelector('.pub-card')?.getAttribute('data-pub-key') ?? null

steps.name: first-shelf-head-is-current
steps.probe: document.querySelector('.pub-current')?.classList.contains('pub-group-head') === true

steps.name: second-shelf-head-is-current
steps.probe: document.querySelector('.pub-current')?.classList.contains('pub-group-head') === true

steps.name: first-card-is-current
steps.probe: document.querySelector('.pub-current')?.getAttribute('data-pub-key') ?? null

steps.name: right-moved-to-same-row-neighbour
steps.probe: (() => { const first = document.querySelector('.pub-card'); const cur = document.querySelector('.pub-current'); if (first === null || cur === null || cur === first) return false; return Math.round(cur.getBoundingClientRect().top) === Math.round(first.getBoundingClientRect().top); })()

steps.name: right-edge-stays-in-first-row
steps.probe: (() => { const first = document.querySelector('.pub-card'); const cur = document.querySelector('.pub-current'); if (first === null || cur === null) return false; return Math.round(cur.getBoundingClientRect().top) === Math.round(first.getBoundingClientRect().top) && cur.getBoundingClientRect().left > first.getBoundingClientRect().left; })()

steps.name: left-edge-returns-to-first-card
steps.probe: document.querySelector('.pub-current') === document.querySelector('.pub-card')

steps.name: head-is-current-before-ctrl
steps.probe: document.querySelector('.pub-current')?.classList.contains('pub-group-head') === true

steps.name: head-left-does-not-collapse-shelf
steps.probe: (() => { const cur = document.querySelector('.pub-current'); if (cur === null) return false; const section = cur.closest('.pub-group'); return section !== null && !section.classList.contains('pub-group-collapsed'); })()

steps.name: shelf-collapsed-by-ctrl-up
steps.probe: (() => { const cur = document.querySelector('.pub-current'); if (cur === null) return false; const section = cur.closest('.pub-group'); return section !== null && section.classList.contains('pub-group-collapsed'); })()

steps.name: shelf-head-still-current-after-collapse
steps.probe: document.querySelector('.pub-current')?.classList.contains('pub-group-head') === true

steps.name: shelf-expanded-by-ctrl-down
steps.probe: (() => { const cur = document.querySelector('.pub-current'); if (cur === null) return false; const section = cur.closest('.pub-group'); return section !== null && !section.classList.contains('pub-group-collapsed'); })()

steps.name: card-is-current-again
steps.probe: document.querySelector('.pub-current')?.getAttribute('data-pub-key') ?? null

steps.name: card-does-not-collapse-shelf
steps.probe: (() => { const cur = document.querySelector('.pub-current'); if (cur === null) return false; const section = cur.closest('.pub-group'); return section !== null && !section.classList.contains('pub-group-collapsed'); })()

steps.name: card-stays-current-after-ctrl-up
steps.probe: document.querySelector('.pub-current')?.getAttribute('data-pub-key') ?? null

steps.name: head-is-current-before-search
steps.probe: document.querySelector('.pub-current')?.classList.contains('pub-group-head') === true

steps.name: search-focused
steps.probe: document.activeElement !== null && document.activeElement.classList.contains('pub-search')

steps.name: search-ctrl-up-collapses-shelf
steps.probe: (() => { const cur = document.querySelector('.pub-current'); if (cur === null) return false; const section = cur.closest('.pub-group'); return section !== null && section.classList.contains('pub-group-collapsed'); })()

steps.name: search-left-does-not-change-shelf
steps.probe: (() => { const cur = document.querySelector('.pub-current'); if (cur === null || !cur.classList.contains('pub-group-head')) return false; const section = cur.closest('.pub-group'); return section !== null && section.classList.contains('pub-group-collapsed'); })()

steps.name: search-ctrl-down-expands-shelf
steps.probe: (() => { const cur = document.querySelector('.pub-current'); if (cur === null) return false; const section = cur.closest('.pub-group'); return section !== null && !section.classList.contains('pub-group-collapsed'); })()

steps.name: switch-to-list-view
steps.eval: (() => { const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.ui-segmented button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Список'); if (btn === undefined) return false; btn.click(); return true; })()

steps.name: focus-first-entry
steps.eval: (() => { const entry = document.querySelector('.pub-entry'); if (entry === null) return false; entry.focus(); return document.activeElement === entry; })()

steps.name: list-head-is-current
steps.probe: document.querySelector('.pub-current')?.classList.contains('pub-group-head') === true

steps.name: list-left-does-not-collapse-shelf
steps.probe: (() => { const cur = document.querySelector('.pub-current'); if (cur === null) return false; const section = cur.closest('.pub-group'); return section !== null && !section.classList.contains('pub-group-collapsed'); })()

steps.name: list-right-does-not-collapse-shelf
steps.probe: (() => { const cur = document.querySelector('.pub-current'); if (cur === null) return false; const section = cur.closest('.pub-group'); return section !== null && !section.classList.contains('pub-group-collapsed'); })()

steps.name: list-ctrl-up-collapses-shelf
steps.probe: (() => { const cur = document.querySelector('.pub-current'); if (cur === null) return false; const section = cur.closest('.pub-group'); return section !== null && section.classList.contains('pub-group-collapsed'); })()

steps.name: list-ctrl-down-expands-shelf
steps.probe: (() => { const cur = document.querySelector('.pub-current'); if (cur === null) return false; const section = cur.closest('.pub-group'); return section !== null && !section.classList.contains('pub-group-collapsed'); })()

steps.name: no-error-banner
steps.probe: document.querySelectorAll('.error-line:not(.hidden), .footer-error:not(.hidden)').length
